author: ID10
body:
• IGN: LavaBlock

  • Reason for ban: I was banned for "Hacking-Autoclicker" (I'm assuming just Autoclicker).

  • Reason why I should be unbanned: I believe I was fasly banned for the use of an Autoclicker as I was not using one, nor have I ever used one before. However you might have believed I was using an Autoclicker due I bug that I noticed on CTH called "fasthit" (as people call it). It's basicly hitting people multiple times in a second. If you play a few games of CTH you're bound to let this happen to you at least once or twice.

@resepignev, joining a game and purposly letting someone kill you once isn't exactly enough evidence to prove that someone is autoclicking. 

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

- LavaBlock

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello LavaBlock,

I'm sorry about the ban, I made a mistake. I forgot that there is the "fasthit glitch" in CTH.
I'll ask for an appeal/removal as soon as possible.

Have a good day!
